output.title: Ingress-shim annotation copying feature available for Ingress resources
output.content: This change adds the --extra-certificate-annotations flag to the ingress-shim component to copy annotations from Ingress resources to created Certificate objects. This feature is available for any cert-manager deployment using Ingress-based certificate automation. The environment shows HTTP challenge role configuration, consistent with Ingress automation. If you use Ingress resources for certificate provisioning and need to propagate annotations to Certificate objects, this feature is now available.
